title: Simple, easy and intuitive!
body:
I’ve been loving the experience so far, and i love how easy navigating is. Plus the animations and the UI are just the right cherry on top. 
I just have a few suggestions:
- Having an option to complete a previous day’s tasks; as sometimes I tens to forget to check it off on done, even if I’ve done the task IRL. So it’d be a good to have at times, as it resets daily at 12 am. another option would be to give customizable daily reset time. 
- Badges should be clickable and show the data related to it. It would make them more interactive and useful, just my opinion. 

Thanks for making this app, it’s a lifesaver!

title: Constant Countdown Timer Detracts from an Otherwise Great App
body: The app is good, but they keep displaying a countdown timer for a lifetime access offer at 1999 INR, instead of the regular price of 39999 INR. This timer has been resetting for the past 4 months. It's frustrating to have to bypass this every time I open the app. I would have given it 5 stars if not for this issue.

title: Easy and effective
body: Have been using done for more than a month and it has been working really well. I have got myself to build simple habits like meditating, riding bicycle, hitting gym and brushing teeth before bed. The interface is simple and gives you a visual status of your habits. I would suggest using the free thing for 3 habits till you become a regular, after that go for the paid plan. It helps in adding any number of habits and also multiple reminders and groups. Overall a perfect app if you wish to build good habits. Cheers to the developers!
author: Navin Kulkarni

title: Good attempt with few unique features
body:
I had attempted to use  paid version of this sophisticated app along with my existing simple app for 1 week. 

Pros
 Elegant & intuitive UI
 Ability track "quit" habits 

 
Cons
-  completed task remains in the screen. 

- LImited scheduling options ( No way to specify non-day specific Weekly or monthly habits ) 

- No way to "Skip" a ( you could not walk as you were sick ). 

Bottomline
good  to track "quit" habitats. 

Note : 
Developers attempt deserve appreciation. Awaiting for better app in forth coming versions. 

For time-being I have stopped using the app and continuing with existing app.
